# settings-group API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/documentation.cjs. Do not edit. -->

Visible settings rows with caller-owned controls and optional built-in Form naming.

## SettingsGroup

Group visible settings in a native medium Fluent Card. The optional header sits outside it.
Text and controls share a fluid wrapping row: compact controls remain beside text
while larger controls move below when they do not fit. Leading text grows from a 160px preferred basis, bounded by the available width.
Requires Fluent theme variables; no SPFx provider, cloned controls or form state.
Text uses semantic wrappers and toolkit typography; strings remain literal.
JSX phrasing children inherit presets without cloning and may supply explicit styling.

### Imports

```ts
import { SettingsGroup } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { SettingsGroup } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import { SettingsGroup } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/settings-group';
```

### Use when

- Related settings should stay visible in a Card with shared row labels and optional Form adapters.

### Avoid when

- Use AccordionGroup when consumers should disclose and collapse sections.

### Examples

#### Compose visible notification settings

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { SettingsGroup } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { Switch } from '@fluentui/react-components';

<SettingsGroup title="Notifications">
  <SettingsGroup.Item title="Email">
    <Switch aria-label="Email alerts" />
  </SettingsGroup.Item>
</SettingsGroup>;
```

## SettingsGroupItemProps

One composable settings row; caller controls retain identity, labels and state.
Named slots accept shorthand, fixed span props (div for action) and render callbacks.
Inner refs/classes/events are forwarded; semantic Label/IDs remain owned by the row.
Opt into field composition to label one built-in Form control using row text.

### Imports (4)

```ts
import type { SettingsGroupItemProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { SettingsGroupItemProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { SettingsGroupItemProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/settings-group';
```

### Examples (5)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { SettingsGroup } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
<SettingsGroup><SettingsGroup.Item title="Profile">Content</SettingsGroup.Item></SettingsGroup>
```

### Type (2)

```ts
interface SettingsGroupItemProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "title" | "dangerouslySetInnerHTML">
```

### Members (3)

| Member | Type | Requirement | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SettingsGroupItemProps.action` | `ContentSlot<"div">` | Optional | — | Optional inner div slot for a secondary caller-owned action, outside the primary controls.<br>When omitted, this action region is absent. |
| `SettingsGroupItemProps.children` | `ReactNode` | Optional | — | Primary controls; field mode supplies one built-in Form control with row naming.<br>When omitted, the row has no primary control content; field mode requires the consumer to supply its Form adapter. |
| `SettingsGroupItemProps.dangerouslySetInnerHTML` | `never` | Forbidden | — | Raw HTML is unsupported; children own panel/control content.<br>Must be omitted or undefined in this branch. |
| `SettingsGroupItemProps.description` | `ContentSlot<"span">` | Optional | — | Optional inner span slot for description phrasing content; span wrapper uses caption1 and subtle foreground.<br>When omitted, this description region is absent. |
| `SettingsGroupItemProps.field` | `boolean \| undefined` | Optional | false | Use title/description as one built-in Form logical control's label/hint.<br>Requires a meaningful title and exactly one primary built-in adapter inside its Form root.<br>Empty/whitespace strings and empty intrinsic markup or Fragments are rejected as titles;<br>populated markup/Fragments and numeric title content remain supported.<br>Custom components and render callbacks must render meaningful accessible title content; their output is caller-owned.<br>Omit the control's label/hint;<br>validation stays in Form. Actions, nested rows and custom useField bindings are excluded.<br>Defaults to false; composite controls name their group instead of every inner control. |
| `SettingsGroupItemProps.icon` | `ContentSlot<"span">` | Optional | — | Optional inner span slot for a decorative icon in a fixed 20px slot; font/SVG children scale without cloning. Hidden from assistive technology.<br>When omitted, this icon region is absent. |
| `SettingsGroupItemProps.title` | `ContentSlot<"span">` | Optional | — | Optional inner span slot (shorthand, native props or render callback); title phrasing content; span wrapper uses body1Strong and primary foreground.<br>When field is omitted or false, omitting title removes this region. Field mode<br>instead requires a meaningful title and throws when it is omitted or empty. |

#### SettingsGroupItemProps.field

##### Default

false

##### Examples (6)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { SettingsGroup, createForm } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { Switch } from '@fluentui/react-components';
const Order = createForm<{ email: boolean }>();
<Order.Root defaultValues={{ email: false }} onSubmit={values => { console.log(values.email); }}><SettingsGroup><SettingsGroup.Item field title="Email" description="Receive alerts"><Order.Switch name="email" /></SettingsGroup.Item></SettingsGroup></Order.Root>
```

## SettingsGroupProps

Native div group attributes and optional header/body content; application controls own
values and validation. Uses the host Fluent theme/renderer with no SPFx provider.
Strings stay literal. Text wrappers apply toolkit presets; JSX children retain their props.
Named props accept shorthand, fixed-tag native props or children render callbacks.
Objects request inner containers; refs identify those containers, not owned headings/Labels.
Callbacks receive the fixed tag/composed props during rendering and must forward the props.
Empty static descriptions do not add accessible associations; raw HTML is unsupported.

### Imports (5)

```ts
import type { SettingsGroupProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { SettingsGroupProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { SettingsGroupProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/settings-group';
```

### Examples (7)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { SettingsGroup } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
<SettingsGroup title="Preferences"><SettingsGroup.Item title="Profile">Content</SettingsGroup.Item></SettingsGroup>
```

### Type (3)

```ts
interface SettingsGroupProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "title" | "dangerouslySetInnerHTML">
```

### Members (4)

| Member | Type | Requirement | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SettingsGroupProps.action` | `ContentSlot<"div">` | Optional | — | Optional inner div slot for caller-owned header actions; when omitted, leaves no action region. |
| `SettingsGroupProps.appearance` | `"filled" \| "alternate" \| "outline" \| undefined` | Optional | 'filled' | Native body Card appearance; when omitted, defaults to `filled`.<br>`alternate` uses Fluent's `filled-alternative` surface; `outline` uses its outlined surface.<br>Appearance changes preserve mounted controls and their state. |
| `SettingsGroupProps.children` | `ReactNode` | Optional | — | Caller-owned compound items or custom content, rendered in declared order.<br>When omitted, no child content is added. |
| `SettingsGroupProps.dangerouslySetInnerHTML` | `never` | Forbidden | — | Raw HTML is unsupported; children and content props are the content pathways.<br>Must be omitted or undefined in this branch. |
| `SettingsGroupProps.description` | `ContentSlot<"span">` | Optional | — | Optional inner span slot for supporting phrasing content; wrapper uses caption1 and subtle foreground.<br>When omitted, this description region is absent. |
| `SettingsGroupProps.headingLevel` | `SettingsGroupHeadingLevel \| undefined` | Optional | 2 | Root title wrapper heading level for strings and JSX; when omitted, defaults to 2. |
| `SettingsGroupProps.icon` | `ContentSlot<"span">` | Optional | — | Optional inner span slot for a decorative header icon in a fixed 24px slot; font/SVG children scale without cloning. Hidden from assistive technology.<br>When omitted, this icon region is absent. |
| `SettingsGroupProps.title` | `ContentSlot<"span">` | Optional | — | Optional inner span slot (shorthand, native props or render callback); heading phrasing content; wrapper uses subtitle2 and primary foreground. No nested headings; when omitted, removes the title region. |
